name: Gamsgrubenweg to the Wasserfallwinkel
why: From the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe through short rock tunnels along the Pasterze, Austria's longest glacier, with the Grossglockner straight across.
book: Grossglockner High Alpine Road toll (open May to October). Bus from Heiligenblut in summer.
dangers: Marmots and ibex close to the path: do not feed them.
Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: start early and be off ridges by 14:00.

points.name: Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe
points.note: The end of the road above the Pasterze glacier.

points.name: Wasserfallwinkel
points.note: A grassy corner with a waterfall, high above the glacier.
